newsletters.author: Jake
newsletters.title: It's Good to Be Back
newsletters.body:
It's good to be back with you fellas. Up is down. Down is up. The Jets and Giants are undefeated. Carson Wentz is QB1. Fries is going above and beyond with his weekly deliverable.

In first place, we have Randy “Andrew” Van Macklemore. Arizona's Carson Beck gives him a dark horse for hottest QB between the waist and ankles. It's a seven way tie but his gentility puts him in first.

Fleish is sitting pretty in second as his team is performing quite wella. Josh Allen might give enough guys in this group a chubani to put his team over the top.

Where there is a Fleish, there is a Jakub. While mono may stop one of his QB's, CTE ain't stopping the Giants' signal caller from bashing skulls, banging chicks, and dunking on them libs. All hot traits.

James, your LinkedIn TV Legal Expert, is next in the crowded yet exclusive 7-way tie for first place. Who woulda thunk that the Jets stopped James from being alone in first place. One of his QB's is not like the others.

Duval City Spence got some heat for drafting the Jags. I thought it was for the hair but maybe our fearless leader knows something we don't. Perhaps we can invest the house money in Relay options.

Speaking of Relay…Swid brought his business acumen that rubbed off from Spence with picking the jets. He loaded up on his odds for the diversity bonus. Smart.

Wolf. Respect the Ravens loyalty and grateful for you organizing this league. I hope your teams win because your guys ain't hot. Idk why but I like your team's odds for having a player come out during the season.

That rounds out the tie for first. Next up is another set of best buds coupled together in the standings. Sexy Craig and Fries.

Craig is in a strong P2 position thanks to the Justin Herbert-slayer and king of cuck, Kirk Cousins. Holy smokes Madison.

Fries. I didn't know you had Carson Wentz when I started this essay, yet somehow it feels right that he catapulted you into second place. Stafford has some real sexy touch of gray working for you. Thanks for cropping my pic for the standings where you did. Mensch.

The only thing smaller than the Speedo in the tundra is my win count. Yikes. Picking the Pats and still being last hurts. At least I am reconnected with you fellow lions for this beautiful football season ❤️
